name: Diatom Plate
desc: A dark-field microscopy plate of diatom frustules drawn Haeckel-style: centric shells radiate as silica rosettes while pennate boats carry a central raphe and ranked transverse costae, every specimen pitted with rows of areolae and rimmed with marginal spines, drifting on slow bounded orbits and turning on two incommensurate rates while an oblique dark-field illumination sweeps round and lights one flank of each shell brighter than the other; detritus of broken shells snows through the field. Offered as glowing dark-field silica, transmitted bright-field, an engraved Kunstformen plate, or false-colour fluorescence.

energy.doc: brightness of the silica scatter and edge glow

scale.doc: magnification into the plate - specimens swell, guaranteed visible change

speed.doc: rate of drift, rotation and the sweeping illumination angle

density.doc: number of specimens on the plate and detritus in the field

ornament.doc: richness of the fine structure - areolae rows, costae count, ring detail

hue.doc: base hue of the silica / iridescence

x.doc: centre of the condenser illumination, horizontal

y.doc: centre of the condenser illumination, vertical

style.doc: aesthetic: glowing silica on black / dark specimens on pale transmitted light / engraved sepia Kunstformen plate / additive false-colour fluorescence

seed.doc: deterministic - re-throws the whole specimen population and their ornamentation
